test_overview: Full end-to-end regression of the ComfortPro Connect MVP core flow (booking → job → invoice) executed via Playwright with two isolated browser contexts. context_A: Client Riley Morgan (riley@example.com) registered, created HVAC/Residential/Repair booking #1 (200 N State St, Chicago; today; AM; "Furnace not heating"); name/email autofilled read-only; booking appears in list; booking detail read-only. context_B: Technician Sam Torres (sam@example.com) registered; navigation correctly lacks Properties; converted Booking #1 → Job #1 (Scheduled, today AM, assigned to Sam); booking no longer in Bookings list. Job status progression enforced strictly: direct skip to Completed not offered (option absent), completion blocked without notes ("At least one note is required before completing the job"), note added, then Completed. Draft invoice #1 ($175.00, due today+14, Sam Torres) visible to technician but NOT to client (client sees 'No invoices yet.'). Sent to client (with confirmation) → client sees Sent invoice, read-only (no action buttons, no editable fields). Technician marked Paid (with confirmation) → status Paid "Aug 8, 2026". Client view of completed job: read-only (no status select, no add-note button, no editable controls) showing status Completed, technician name, address, and notes. Every FATAL and non-fatal verification passed. Final score: 70/70.

steps.description: test_client_creates_booking: Client Riley Morgan signed up successfully; signed in confirmed; nav provides Properties/Bookings/Jobs/Invoices. New booking form: name and email autofilled read-only (verified by typing attempt - readonly). Submitted booking HVAC/Residential/Repair/Standard, phone 3125550199, 200 N State St, Chicago IL 60601, today, AM, 'Furnace not heating'. Booking #1 created (uniquely identified on confirmation page), appears in client Bookings list, detail fully read-only for client.

test_technician_converts_booking_to_job: Technician Sam Torres signed up; nav has Bookings/Jobs/Invoices with no Properties link. Located Riley Morgan's Booking #1, converted to Job with scheduled date today and AM window. Job #1 created with status 'Scheduled', Technician: Sam Torres, appears in technician Jobs list; booking removed from Bookings list ('No active bookings.').

test_job_status_progression: Job #1 initially Scheduled. Direct skip to Completed not offered (status dropdown only provides 'In Progress' while Scheduled) - blocked. Changed to In Progress successfully. Completion without notes blocked with message 'At least one note is required before completing the job'. Added note 'Replaced igniter; furnace heating restored.', then changed to Completed successfully with toast and Completed timestamp. Note visible on job detail.

test_invoice_draft_visibility: From completed job, created invoice $175.00 due 2026-08-22 (today+14); remained Draft. Invoice #1 detail visible to technician: Status Draft, Amount $175.00, Due Aug 22 2026, Technician Sam Torres. Client's Invoices view shows 'No invoices yet.' - Draft not visible to client.

test_send_invoice_and_mark_paid: Technician sent Draft invoice (confirmed dialog) -> status Sent. Client now sees Sent Invoice #1 in list and detail: $175.00, due Aug 22 2026, Technician Sam Torres, fully read-only (no Edit/Send/Void/Mark-paid buttons, 0 editable controls). Technician marked Paid (confirmed dialog) -> status Paid with 'Paid: Aug 8, 2026'.

test_client_job_read_only: Client opened completed Job #1 from 'My Jobs'. Status shown as Completed; technician name (Sam Torres), address (200 N State St, Chicago, IL 60601), and note ('Replaced igniter; furnace heating restored.') displayed. No status dropdown, no Add Note button, no editable controls (all counts 0) - job fully read-only for client.
